images.prompt: A simple diagram illustrating diversification. On one side, a single large basket overflowing with identical items (e.g., apples), labeled "Undiversified Portfolio - High Risk." On the other side, multiple smaller baskets, each containing different types of items (e.g., apples, oranges, bananas, grapes), labeled "Diversified Portfolio - Lower Risk." Arrows indicate potential loss from dropping a single basket in the undiversified scenario versus minimal impact in the diversified scenario.
